# reselling_rootserver_volume (Resource)

A block storage volume on a cluster. Attach it with `reselling_rootserver_volume_attachment`, so that the volume survives when a server is replaced. A volume only grows, and only while it is attached.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "reselling_storage_classes" "fra" {
  cluster_id = data.reselling_locations.fra.locations[0].clusters[0].id
}

resource "reselling_rootserver_volume" "data" {
  name             = "data"
  storage_class_id = data.reselling_storage_classes.fra.storage_classes[0].id
  size_gb          = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name. Changed in place.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in GB. Grows in place while the volume is attached; a smaller value replaces the volume (all data is lost).
- `storage_class_id` (String) Storage class (see data source `reselling_storage_classes`); it decides the cluster the volume lives on. Changing it replaces the volume.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `device` (String)
- `guest_device_path` (String) Stable path of the disk inside the guest.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location_id` (String)
- `server_id` (String) Server the volume is attached to, if any.
- `status` (String)

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_rootserver_volume.data <volume_id>
```
